account: It is day 0, about 11:19. I have finished my scheduled market walk and reached home ahead of lunch at noon. So far I have seen no clear sign of anything unusual in town. Townsfolk 18 and 28 reported that the baker was carrying a sack of wheat at the bakery; Townsfolk 08 repeated the same news. That sounds consistent with supplying the bakery for bread-making, though I have not seen the delivery myself and do not know its purpose for certain. Other residents I asked had no news. The secretary is investigating my three o'clock tea appointment because the appointment book names only a neighbour at a dockside cottage on the east bank, without an exact host or address. She said she would confirm the host and report before tea, either at my home around noon or at the office after one. She has the appointment book with her. My remaining scheduled business today is lunch at home, town accounts in the office at one, dockside tea at three, the office at four-thirty, and home at seven. There is also a grain inspection at the mill tomorrow at ten. I have no evidence connecting that inspection, the baker's wheat, or the tea appointment beyond their ordinary places in town life.
